changelog:
v2.6.7 — THE BLIND FREEZER FIX (root cause found by the owner himself!):

🎯 The mystery is solved: stuck frozen apps were showing as ACTIVE on the Freezer screen — so tapping them was re-FREEZING them instead of unfreezing. The screen was blind to the old freeze state.

Why: the app read the frozen list through shell pm list flags, but your Android 11 Samsung doesn't support the flag that lists suspended apps (the exact state the old freeze used). The list came back empty — frozen apps looked active forever.

✅ The fix: the app now reads frozen state straight from the OS package manager's own flags — sees BOTH freeze states (disabled + suspended), works on every Android version, no shell needed.

✅ Stuck apps will now finally appear in the ❄ FROZEN section — tap them and the pm unsuspend artillery releases the old freeze for real.

✅ Freezer Doctor now targets the truth-frozen set and reports OS flags per app.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.6.
